parameters.subject: =Welcome to Twinn.live – Customer Outreach Executive
parameters.message:
=Dear {{$('Parse Score').first().json["name"]}},

Thank you for confirming your interest in joining Twinn.live as a Customer Outreach Executive. We are excited to welcome you to Twinn.live, an AI-powered platform helping brands, creators, and businesses create, connect, and sell through innovative AI-powered digital experiences.

As a Customer Outreach Executive, you will be responsible for identifying potential customers, reaching out to brands and businesses, understanding their requirements, introducing Twinn.live solutions, and maintaining consistent follow-ups with potential clients.

Your Key Responsibilities
- Research and identify potential brands and businesses that can benefit from Twinn.live.
- Generate and maintain qualified leads.
- Reach out to potential customers through LinkedIn, Instagram, email, WhatsApp, and other approved channels.
- Create personalized outreach messages based on the prospect's business.
- Introduce Twinn.live and explain how our solutions can help their business.
- Follow up with interested prospects regularly.
- Maintain accurate lead and outreach records.
- Schedule meetings or demos with interested prospects.
- Understand customer requirements and communicate them to the relevant team.
- Submit regular outreach and progress reports.
- Work toward assigned outreach and lead-generation goals.

What We're Looking For
We are looking for candidates who:
- Have good communication skills.
- Can communicate confidently with business owners and potential customers.
- Are comfortable with online research and social media.
- Can write professional messages and emails.
- Are proactive and willing to take initiative.
- Can handle follow-ups professionally.
- Are interested in startups, AI, technology, and business development.
- Can work independently as well as with a team.

What You'll Get
- Full-time employment opportunity
- Hands-on experience in customer outreach and business development
- Exposure to a fast-growing AI startup environment
- Experience working with brands and business owners
- Practical experience in B2B outreach and lead generation
- Opportunity to work with AI-powered products and solutions
- Performance-based recognition and growth opportunities
- Opportunity to contribute to real-world business projects

Next Steps
- Explore the Twinn.live website and understand our products and services.
- Go through our social media and LinkedIn profiles to understand our vision.
- You will be added to the respective Twinn.live communication group.
- Complete the onboarding process and training provided by the team.
- Start researching and reaching out to potential customers according to the assigned process.
- Maintain your daily outreach and lead records.
- Submit your progress reports regularly.

About Twinn.live
Twinn.live is building AI-powered solutions that help businesses and brands create, connect, and sell through innovative digital experiences.

Connect With Us
Twinn.live LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/twinnlive
Founder: https://www.linkedin.com/in/parkqwikarunkumar/

Need Help?
For any questions or assistance, please contact us on WhatsApp: YOUR_WHATSAPP_NUMBER

We are excited to have you join Twinn.live and look forward to building something impactful together.

Best Regards,
Team Twinn.live
